summary.text: Ashley Banks, an independent write-in candidate and Chicago-area freelance journalist, photographer and election judge, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Illinois's 2nd District to Donna Miller.

paragraphs.text: Banks was born in Chicago and says in her Ballotpedia survey that she is 40 years old and was born and raised in Illinois. She graduated from Crete-Monee High School.

By her own account she is completing a journalism degree at Olive-Harvey College and an international marketing degree at DePaul University, and she attended Central Arizona College for teaching. She says she has worked as a tutor for DePaul University, a CTA bus driver, a truck driver and an Amazon warehouse employee.

Banks describes herself as a freelance journalist, photographer and election judge who has been involved in politics and community work since her teenage years; Ballotpedia lists her profession as entrepreneur. She declared as a write-in independent candidate for the November 3, 2026 general election.
In her Ballotpedia survey she described her campaign, "Banks for IL-02," as focused on respect, value and transparency in government.
She lost to Donna Miller, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
